institution-1.title: Stellenberg High School
institution-1.content: I started attending Stellenberg High School in January 2018 and completed my matriculation in December 2022. During my time at Stellenberg, I took seven subjects: English Home Language, Afrikaans Home Language, Mathematics, Life Orientation, Life Sciences (Biology), Computer Application Technology, and Information Technology. I achieved six A's and one B in my final matric exams, earning me an A average. My experience at Stellenberg High School provided me with a solid academic foundation and helped me develop important skills such as critical thinking, problem-solving, and effective communication.

institution-2.title: Eduvos
institution-2.grade: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (Software Engineering)
institution-2.content: At Eduvos, I have taken a variety of modules that have provided me with the necessary knowledge and skills in the field of software engineering. Some of the topics covered in my studies were the fundamentals of programming, algorithms and data structures, user experience design, research methodology, web development, mobile app development, database management, software project management, and business management. I did my elective in Java, which focused my knowledge on programming concepts in Java. These include object-oriented programming, data types and variables, control flow, exception handling, file I/O, data structures, algorithms, GUI development using JavaFX, database connectivity with JDBC, and enterprise programming with Jakarta EE.

institution-3.title: Eduvos
institution-3.grade: Bachelor of Science Honours in Information Technology (Software Engineering)
institution-3.content: I am currently pursuing my Bachelor of Science Honours in Information Technology at Eduvos.

course-1.title: CS50x: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
course-1.content: CS50x is an entry-level course presented by Harvard University. While taking this course, I learned foundational programming concepts including algorithms, data structures, software engineering, and web development. The course covered languages such as C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript, and provided hands-on experience through various projects and problem sets.

course-2.title: Lua Programming and Game Development with LÖVE2D
course-2.content: This course, presented by Kyle Schaub on Udemy, focuses on programming in Lua and game development using the LÖVE2D framework. Throughout the course, I learned the fundamentals of Lua programming, including syntax, control structures, functions, and tables. Additionally, I gained practical experience in game development by creating various 2D games using LÖVE2D, covering topics such as graphics rendering, user input handling, and game physics.

course-3.title: Stellenberg High School Web Development
course-3.content: This course was presented at my high school as a form of extra enrichment. I learned the basics of web development including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The course covered fundamental concepts such as structuring web pages, styling with CSS, and adding interactivity using JavaScript. With our final project being a simple portfolio website, I gained hands-on experience in building simple web applications and websites.

course-4.title: CS50g: CS50's Introduction to Game Development
course-4.content: CS50g is a course offered by Harvard University that focuses on the process of game development. While taking this course, I learned about various game development concepts including 2D and 3D graphics, physics simulation, animation, game loops, game states, and user input handling. The course utilized frameworks such as Unity and LÖVE, and provided practical experience through the creation of multiple game projects.

course-5.title: Computer Science for Game Development
course-5.content: By completing this Professional Certificate program from Harvard University, it is proof that I have completed CS50x and CS50g, the two courses that this program is comprised of. This program has provided me with a solid foundation in computer science principles and game development techniques, equipping me with the skills necessary to pursue a career in the game development industry.

course-6.title: Stellenberg High School Java Coding
course-6.content: This course was presented at my high school as a form of extra enrichment. I learned the basics of Java programming such as data types, variables, Java Classes, functions, and control flow. Through practical exercises and projects, I gained hands-on experience in writing Java code and developing simple applications.

course-7.title: PHP From Scratch 2024 | Beginner To Advanced
course-7.content: This course, presented by Brad Traversy on Udemy, focuses on PHP programming from beginner to advanced levels. Throughout the course, I learned the fundamentals of PHP, including syntax, data types, control structures, functions, and object-oriented programming. Additionally, I gained practical experience in building dynamic web applications using PHP, covering topics such as form handling, session management, database integration with MySQL, routing, and building a custom framework similar to Laravel.

course-8.title: Laravel & PHP Mastery: Build 5 Real-World Projects
course-8.content: This course, presented by Piotr Jura on Udemy, focuses on mastering Laravel and PHP by building five real-world projects. Throughout the course, I learned advanced PHP programming concepts and Laravel framework features, including routing, middleware, Eloquent ORM, authentication, and RESTful API development. The course provided hands-on experience in building practical applications such as a task manager, blog platform, e-commerce site, social media app, and a project management tool, equipping me with the skills to develop robust web applications using Laravel and PHP.

project-1.title: Van Zyl Wedding Website
project-1.content: I developed a simple wedding website for a family member's wedding using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The site is intended to display information about the event, display its location with an interactive map, and served as a way of sending in an RSVP for the wedding via an embedded form. This has been disabled now that the wedding has passed.

project-2.title: Portfolio Website
project-2.content: This is my personal portfolio website intended to display my education, certificates, experience, and projects. I challenged myself to make this website look as modern and professional as possible without using any frameworks or libraries. The website is built using vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
